name: for-you-card
title: For You Card
description: One thing waiting on a person in For you: the verb, who asks, the deciding facts, what happens if nobody answers, the source's body and options (the preferred one secondary, never filled), its outcome once settled.

meta.whenToUse: A decision, answer, review, fix or suggestion waiting on one person in the Inbox's For you tab or the phone's For you page.
meta.whenNotToUse: A notification that only informs (InboxItem), or an ask inside a chat (AskCard).
